title: A Stereotype Content Analysis on Color-related Social Bias in Large Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model descriptions of generated images where the visual color tones (red, blue, white) are strictly controlled, using sentiment analysis (VADER) and Stereotype Content Model (SCM) metrics for competence and warmth to detect color-related social stereotypes.
Comparing model descriptions of paired images showing men versus women in identical occupational scenarios, measured via VADER sentiment scores and SCM competence and warmth dimensions.

Analyzing descriptions of paired images featuring individuals from six different racial groups in identical occupational contexts, utilizing VADER sentiment analysis and SCM-based word embedding projections for competence and warmth.
